summary.text: Larry Kraft is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 46A, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Karl Olson. A former high-tech marketing executive and St. Louis Park City Council member, he has said climate policy is a top priority.

paragraphs.text: Larry Kraft lives in St. Louis Park, Minnesota.
He earned a B.S. in computer science in 1987 and an M.B.A. in 1988, both from Cornell University.

Ballotpedia says he worked as vice president of marketing at ISDN Systems Corporation, at Netfax, at Advanced Switching Communications and at Digi International, and was elected to the St. Louis Park City Council.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Kraft said he spent 25 years in the high-tech industry, then changed careers in 2013 and for five years ran a national nonprofit that helped young people advocate for tougher local climate policy.
He listed climate change among his highest policy priorities.
Kraft defeated John Nagel in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 46A.
Ballotpedia lists him as co-vice chair of the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee for 2025-2026.
